verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only manual building blocks for cross-session memory. Project rules persist domain knowledge that the agent reuses across sessions, but a person has to write them. Hooks (sessionStart/sessionEnd/preCompact) and cloud 'durable agents' could be used to build a custom memory layer. Nothing documents the agent automatically building or recalling memories on its own. Missing for 10: a documented automatic memory feature, agent-generated memories that persist across sessions, automatic recall/retrieval of past-session context, and hands-on corroboration.
